result.title: SpatialArena: Where Do Geometric Foundation Models Stand?
result.summary: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry. However, their progress cannot be measured reliably. Published numbers are not comparable, because every paper samples frames, sets resolutions, and selects test splits differently. They are not robust because the alignment required for every up-to-scale prediction can outweigh the gap between models: fitting depth in the wrong space nearly triples its error, and standard trajectory alignment understates the error of failing methods by up to $2.6\times$. And they rarely cover long recordings, dynamic scenes, or aerial views. We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment. SpatialArena spans five tasks, from monocular depth to SLAM. It covers 23 public datasets with 418,929 images across indoor, outdoor, aerial, object-centric, and dynamic scenes, together with Spatial Arena, our own captures with accurate poses and depth. Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models. The benchmark, toolbox, and leaderboard will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: SpatialArena 提出统一的几何基础模型评测平台，用相同指标与鲁棒的确定性对齐，在 23 个公开数据集、52 个模型上比较单目深度、前馈 3D/4D 重建与 SLAM 等五类任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对齐空间选错可使深度误差近三倍、近期增益来自跨帧跨视角一致性」的结论，可能为 LVR 中几何信息是否被保留、及跨推理步状态一致性的评价设计提供参照；但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或 VLM 推理机制。
